tiling.note: End posts are centred on x = -1 and x = +1; place segments 2.0 apart so neighbours share one post.

hero_slot.note: Where the hero recognition pearl floats, glTF coordinates (Y up, piece base on y = 0). A pearl of up to free_radius fits between the floor, the columns and the ring beam.

layout.open_side: -Y in Blender, +Z in glTF (faces the camera)
